notes.title: Achievements & Leaderboards Updated!
notes.content:
The Windows version of Supercharged Robot VULKAISER has been updated make improvements to the achievements and leaderboards, namely:

[list][*] All of the noted broken achievements were related to game clear and this has been adjusted to resolve the issues.
[*] The leaderboards were calculating difficulty incorrectly, so fresh boards have been made (due to the nature of the issue) and the base issue has been fixed.
[*] Destroy [i]X[/i] enemies achievements now show a progress bar.[/list]

Linux versions will also be updated in the next couple of days.

Thank you to all who provided feedback in the Steam discussions group!
